async def act(page):
    # Click on the first 'Sales' link to avoid ambiguity
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Sales', exact=True).first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now click on 'Orders' under Sales; wait for it to appear
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Orders', exact=True).click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # On the Orders page, filter for 'Fraud Suspect' status
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status').select_option(label='Fraud Suspect')
    # Apply the filter by clicking the 'Search' button
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Sort by 'Created' date ascending to get the earliest order
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Created').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Get the customer name from the first row of the results
    first_row = page.get_by_role('row').nth(1)  # Assuming header is row 0
    customer_name_cell = first_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(2)  # Adjust index if needed
    customer_name = await customer_name_cell.text_content()
    return customer_name.strip()
